height.description: Height as a percentage of panel height. Optional in old projects (filled in on load). The text is scaled to fit the bubble.

tailX.description: Where the pointer tip aims, as a percentage of panel width. Speech and thought bubbles only.

tailY.description: Where the pointer tip aims, as a percentage of panel height. Speech and thought bubbles only.

width.description: Width as a percentage of panel width.

x.description: Left offset as a percentage of panel width.

y.description: Top offset as a percentage of panel height.

description.description: Visual description + continuity notes for image-prompt generation.

sceneIds.description: Scene ids this character appears in.

description.description: Visual description + continuity notes for image-prompt generation.

imageIds.description: MediaItem ids (reference art for the object).

sceneIds.description: Scene ids where the object appears.

prompt.description: The intent of the whole page: what happens, its mood and pacing. Stitched, first, into the prompt for every layer's image on the page.

aspectRatio.description: Width / height of the layer's artwork; shapes a layer with no image yet and tells whoever generates the art what proportions to use.

flipX.description: When true the layer's image is mirrored left to right. Absent means not flipped.

sceneId.description: Optional id of the scene (metadata.scenes) a background layer is the setting of. The media picker lists that scene's art first. May name a scene that has since been deleted.

subjectId.description: Optional id of the character or object (metadata.characters or metadata.objects) this layer shows. The media picker lists that subject's art first. May name an entity that has since been deleted.

mediaId.description: Optional id into metadata.media: the MediaItem this layer's artwork came from.

prompt.description: What this layer's art shows: its own part of the image prompt, or a plain description. The page prompt, the panel prompt and the story bible supply the rest.

src.description: Google Drive URL of the image, e.g. https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/<id>?alt=media, or an empty string while the layer is only a prompt. Images are never stored anywhere else. Older projects with a driveFileId are converted on load.

width.description: Width as a percentage of panel width. Aspect ratio is preserved; never stretch.

x.description: Left offset as a percentage of panel width (ignored for a background layer, which fills the panel).

y.description: Top offset as a percentage of panel height.

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file id of the image in the project folder.

sceneId.description: Optional id of the scene this image is art of (a background), not its reference art (the scene's imageIds).

subjectId.description: Optional id of the character or object this image is art of (not its reference art, which is the entity's imageIds).

thumbnailDriveFileId.description: Optional Google Drive file id of a small copy of the image (about 256px on its long side) shown in lists and pickers instead of the full file.

url.description: Drive URL for the file. Fetching the bytes needs a valid Drive access token.

prompt.description: The intent of the panel: what it shows and why (moment, camera, mood). Stitched after the page prompt and before each layer's prompt into the prompt for every layer's image in the panel.

x.description: Left edge as a percentage of page width. x, y, width and height are optional in old projects (filled in on load) but must all be present when any is.

y.description: Top edge as a percentage of page height.

width.description: Width as a percentage of page width. The panels of a page tile it.

height.description: Height as a percentage of page height.

ProjectMetadata.description: Story bible + media registry for the project.

PageSize.description: Physical page dimensions for the comic.

characterIds.description: Character ids that appear in this scene.

description.description: Setting description: location, time of day, mood, lighting.

imageIds.description: MediaItem ids (reference art for the scene).

description: A generic VibeComics project: pages of panels, each panel compositing image layers with speech bubbles on top, plus a story-bible metadata block (outline, characters, scenes, objects, media registry). Page numbers are 0-based and displayed as 0, 1, 2, ...

savedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last autosave write to Drive. Shown in the header as the 'Saved …' line.

title.description: Project title shown in the header.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last content change.
